mcp_tools.name: license_compliance_check
mcp_tools.title: License compliance check
mcp_tools.description: Submit a licence-posture manifest (components, licences, distribution model); get a deterministic COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE check across licence files, dependency compatibility, contributor terms, and claims/contracts, with per-check evidence. A check over declared evidence, not legal advice.

inputSchema.description: The licence-posture manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and component-list schema).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid; no copyleft or attribution requirements triggered.
